largest_and_smallest_classes: Dandelions have the most usable images: 898. Daisies have the fewest: 633.
ambiguous_training_examples: Some photos show distant flowers, multiple flowers, grayscale images, or unusual edited colours. These may be harder to classify.
possible_background_bias: Some tulip photos include buildings and windmills. The model could learn these backgrounds instead of the flower's shape and appearance.
why_validation_and_test_are_separate: Validation data helps us choose model settings and improvements. The test set stays separate for the final evaluation on images that did not guide those choices.
why_augmentation_is_training_only: Augmentation adds variety to training images. Validation and test images use fixed preprocessing so evaluations remain consistent and comparable.
